entities.summary: Natalia Alekseevna Shelikhova, was a Russian businessperson and the wife of Grigory Shelikhov, founder of Russian Alaska. She was one of the founders of the Russian-American Company and has been referred to as one of the first successful female entrepreneurs in Russia.
